description: This file defines the class RegexStreamNamespacePredicate, which implements the IStreamNamespacePredicate interface. It provides functionality to filter stream namespaces using regular expressions, including a constructor to initialize the regex and a method to check if a namespace matches the pattern.

classes.name: RegexStreamNamespacePredicate
classes.description: A class that filters stream namespaces based on a regular expression pattern.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Returns the pattern used to describe this predicate, combining the 'regex:' prefix with the regex pattern.

methods.name: RegexStreamNamespacePredicate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the regex with the provided pattern, throwing an exception if null.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Checks if the given stream namespace matches the regex pattern.
